Title: Zagara Patch
Subtitle: New hero: Zagara
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Zagara, Broodmother of the Swarm:
  • - Trait — Creep Tumor (D): Spawns a Creep Tumor that generates Creep, allowing Zagara and her minions to move faster.
  • - Baneling Barrage (Q): Launches a stream of Banelings that explode on contact with enemies.
  • - Hunter Killer (W): Unleashes a Hunter Killer Hydralisk to attack and chase an enemy.
  • - Infested Drop (E): Bombards an area with a Zerg Drop Pod that spawns Roachlings.
  • - Nydus Network (R1): Places Nydus Worms to quickly traverse the Battleground.
  • - Devouring Maw (R2): Summons a giant Maw to engulf enemies in an area, disabling and damaging them.
